wifi.title: WiFi grill
wifi.description: Enter the grill ID shown in the PitBoss app under grill settings. It looks like PBL-F4CFA2B1E8C4.

password.title: Grill password
password.description: The grill password is set in the PitBoss app (grill settings). Leave blank only if the grill has no password. Without the correct password Home Assistant can still read temperatures but cannot change them.

reauth_confirm.title: Grill password rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {grill} rejected the stored password, so temperature changes are failing. The grill password is set in the PitBoss app (grill settings). Leave blank only if the grill has no password. Without the correct password Home Assistant can still read temperatures but cannot change them.

reconfigure.title: Update grill password
reconfigure.description: The grill password is set in the PitBoss app (grill settings). Leave blank only if the grill has no password. Without the correct password Home Assistant can still read temperatures but cannot change them.

error.invalid_auth: The grill rejected this password. Check it in the PitBoss app under grill settings.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the grill. Make sure it is powered on and online.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_devices_found: No PitBoss grills found over Bluetooth.
abort.reauth_successful: Password accepted. Controls are working again.

invalid_password.message: The grill rejected the password. Update it under Settings > Devices & services > PitBoss > Reconfigure.

not_connected.message: The grill is not connected right now.

grill_off.message: The grill is off. Start it at the grill, then set the temperature.

power_on_unsupported.message: PitBoss grills cannot be started remotely. Start it at the grill.
